purpose: Assess a genuinely useful next productive word-building operation independently of966's manual comparison trial, without native values or data. The candidate considered was deriving an action participant description from one learned action root.

actual_hand_operation_considered.operation: A writer reuses a learned action root and an overt role operator to say someone who did this action, something acted upon, or its result, while retaining the other explicitly written argument and temporal/event scope.
actual_hand_operation_considered.minimal_exact_semantics: For an explicitly supplied episode domain T and learned binary-action relation GRIND(e,x,y), AGENT_OF_GRIND_RYE denotes the predicate lambda x: there exists e in T with GRIND(e,x,rye). It does not itself denote one uniquely selected person. A patient projection abstracts y instead and must retain the actor. A result projection additionally requires an actually learned result relation; it cannot be inferred freely for every verb.
actual_hand_operation_considered.human_use: Repeated references to a participant's task could share one action root instead of learning a separate opaque word for every occupational or episodic description. This is a modern constructional illustration, not a medieval attestation or a native word reading.
actual_hand_operation_considered.paid_learning: The action root still costs its learned meaning, argument order/types, event-versus-disposition interpretation and any result relation. Role selection is a reusable grammatical operation, not free knowledge of an unknown root. Episode scope, reference selection, names, negation and the complete physical carrier must be written by the eventual contract.

concrete_content_countercase.invented_example: Ada ground rye. Bela ground rye. Give the bowl to Ada.
concrete_content_countercase.required_distinction: Both Ada and Bela satisfy the episodic rye-grinder predicate. Replacing the last Ada by an unqualified rye-grinder description loses the intended recipient. 'Give to every rye-grinder', 'give to some rye-grinder', and 'give to Ada' have different intended contents and cannot share one allegedly unambiguous reference by an appeal to context.
concrete_content_countercase.scope_counterpair: Ada did not grind rye in T versus Ada ground something that is not rye in T. Negating the participant predicate and negating its material argument are not interchangeable. Habitual capability to grind is likewise not an assertion of a completed grinding event.
concrete_content_countercase.what_this_changes: A future role-word writer must choose whether its derived item is a predicate, a set description or a referential term, then pay the relevant quantifier/identity and episode boundary. A single-actor example cannot discriminate these alternatives. This is a concrete authoring obligation, not a proposed native census or another test of the old single-actor traces.

primary_predecessors.boundary: Already proposes an agent-suppressing result construction with the affected item retained. It is not a complete physical writer, and merely introducing omission or passive/result terminology is not new.

primary_predecessors.retained_result: The fixed process-frame to faculty-specification NOM extension fails on the IT/RF repeated operator because its output is not its own input type. ZL remains incomplete. This is not a universal ban on productive nominalization; adding an idempotent cast after the failure would change that frozen contract.

Returned Person references are consumed, but strict returned-payload composition is bypassed through the original material register. ORIGIN, LAST_WORKING and ADDRESSEE all select the same person in the frozen one-actor histories. No further identical one-actor replay is discriminating. Historical guessed native values in this report are not reused here.

A genuine current/change predication fragment remains partial because ownership and intervening scope are unpaid. The exact static continuation contradicts its own unchanged profile. This later positive does not supersede1046 or supply the missing reference and event scope of a new role grammar.

selection.decision: No new RAW card and no new manual trial selected from this block. The productive role-selection idea is not a sufficiently different complete22-sign writer after the concrete prior work. The explicit two-actor/negation countercase is retained as a construction obligation rather than pretending that a new example supplies a carrier.
selection.not_claimed: No assertion that all possible role-nominalization writers have been exhausted, no general morphology rejection, no unreviewed-equals-unexecuted inference, no native meaning assignment and no statistic fitting. Existing raw alternatives retain their statuses.
